meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: 实现完成后,Claude 会自己在真实界面手动跑 QA 并留下证据,再启动一名 gate reviewer 审查目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文与 QA 证据。QA 矩阵若出现失败行即判 REVIEW FAILED,否则等该审查者给出 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接之前,或你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。它先收集目标、约束、改动文件和 diff。

say.text: 准备提 PR 了,先帮我跑一轮 gate review
say.note: 先做手动 QA,有失败行就直接判 REVIEW FAILED

say.text: 审查一下我刚实现的登录功能
say.note: 变更集交给单个 gate reviewer 审核

say.text: 对这次改动做手动 QA,并把证据记进 QA 矩阵
say.note: 每行要附证据,否则不算 PASS

howto.what_en: After an implementation, Claude runs hands-on QA itself on the real surface, records evidence, then launches ONE gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context and QA evidence. Failing QA rows stop it.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. It first gathers the goal, constraints, changed files and the diff.

say_en.text: I'm about to hand off a PR - run a gate review first
say_en.note: Manual QA runs first; a failing row ends the review

say_en.text: Review the login feature I just implemented
say_en.note: The change set goes to a single gate reviewer

say_en.text: Run manual QA on this change and log evidence in the QA matrix
say_en.note: Rows without an artifact path are not PASS
